title: Benchmarking Test-Time Adaptation against Distribution Shifts in Image Classification
read_scope: Primary metadata, abstract, author repository README; no full experiment audit
method_overlap: Unified 13 methods/variants and online/offline, instance/batch/domain adaptation over CIFAR10/100-C, ImageNet-C, DomainNet, Office-Home.
limitation: Version and access regimes must be matched; source does not establish 2026 leaderboard.
publication_status: arXiv preprint 2307.03133; no later venue verified

title: Evaluation of Test-Time Adaptation Under Computational Time Constraints
read_scope: Official proceedings abstract/metadata and original arXiv abstract; no full method audit
method_overlap: Already evaluates online adaptation using a constant-rate stream that reduces adaptation access for slower methods.
limitation: Choice of arrival model matters; this protocol is not all possible latency-sensitive deployment.
publication_status: Official ICML2024 proceedings verified; preprint began April2023

title: RobustBench: a standardized adversarial robustness benchmark
read_scope: Official abstract and current author-maintained repository/site; not all leaderboard methods audited
method_overlap: Standardized models and corruption metrics/checkpoints; ImageNet-3DCC extension.
limitation: Primarily robustness benchmark; a fixed checkpoint score does not uniquely specify a streaming TTA protocol.

title: Improving robustness against common corruptions by covariate shift adaptation
read_scope: Primary abstract, metadata, author project page; selective PDF header inspection
method_overlap: Strong simple BN-statistics adaptation across models; essential cheap baseline and robust-source comparison.
limitation: Multiple target examples and contamination/class-mixture assumptions matter; improvements do not prove arbitrary covariate-shift correction.

title: AugMix: A Simple Data Processing Method to Improve Robustness and Uncertainty
read_scope: Official conference abstract/author metadata, arXiv and author repository method/checkpoint description
method_overlap: Robust source-training control using mixed augmentations and consistency; available ResNet50 checkpoint.
limitation: Source training intervention, not test-time policy selection; compare same preparation and checkpoint quality.

title: Extending the WILDS Benchmark for Unsupervised Adaptation
read_scope: Primary abstract/metadata, official WILDS data and submission documentation; no full experimental audit
method_overlap: Adds curated unlabeled splits to 8 of10 WILDS datasets with unchanged labeled splits/metrics; adaptation success is limited.
limitation: Designated unlabeled adaptation before final evaluation differs from adapting on test inputs.
publication_status: Preprint submitted December2021; latest arXiv v2 April2022; venue not independently verified

title: ACDC: The Adverse Conditions Dataset With Correspondences for Semantic Driving Scene Understanding
read_scope: Official proceedings metadata/abstract and author dataset overview
method_overlap: Real fog/night/rain/snow driving scenes and normal correspondences; dense prediction extension beyond artificial corruptions.
limitation: Later TPAMI extension has revised title, additional authors/annotations; do not silently merge versions or use panoptic metrics as semantic mIoU.

title: 3D Common Corruptions for Object Recognition
venue: ICML 2022 Shift Happens workshop / benchmark report
read_scope: Benchmark PDF title/authors, abstract and sections1-2; author project news and RobustBench link
method_overlap: ImageNet-3DCC12 corruptions, many incorporating inferred depth; useful held-out physical-transformation families.
limitation: OpenReview HTML challenged; short paper generic ICML footer is not proof of main-track status; derived images share clean IDs with ImageNet-C.
publication_status: 2022 benchmark report verified; workshop designation supported by linked project ecosystem, main-track not established

title: UniTTA: Unified Benchmark and Versatile Framework Towards Realistic Test-Time Adaptation
read_scope: Abstract, sections3-5 and AppendixB selected passages, official README
method_overlap: Markov domain/class correlation and imbalance;36 formal cases,24 evaluated; domain-class balanced statistics, dynamic domain expansion and correlated feature adaptation.
limitation: Independent domain/class sampling is a modeled regime, not arbitrary real causal dependence. Repo warns optimized sampler may change published numbers.
publication_status: arXiv July2024; later venue not verified

title: Realistic Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
read_scope: Official abstract/metadata and PDF introduction/figure1; partial reading
method_overlap: Variable effective class count and non-i.i.d. batches can undermine VLM adaptation; StatA anchors initial text knowledge.
limitation: CLIP/VLM and cluster/semantic priors differ from ordinary source classifiers; no claim that all methods collapse universally.

title: What Drives Test-Time Adaptation for CLIP? A Controlled Empirical Study from an Update Perspective
read_scope: arXiv v3 metadata and selective fulltext reading sections2-5, AppendixB/E; author site. Lead additionally checked Table4 and table/prose consistency.
method_overlap: 20+ CLIP methods, parameter/state/inference taxonomy, shift-dependent paradigm preferences; dynamic paradigm selection listed as future problem.
limitation: CLIP classification; paradigm preferences do not certify novel routing. Venue author-reported, not independently checked in proceedings. V3 natural-average prose and tables disagree (e.g. TPS63.01 vs64.46); numerical use must identify its exact table. Metadata title uses 'an Update', HTML heading 'a Update'.
publication_status: ArXiv v1 June12 and v3 October12 2026 verified; venue author-reported

title: On the Learnability of Test-Time Adaptation: A Recovery Complexity Perspective
read_scope: Official proceedings abstract and metadata only; full proofs not read
method_overlap: Recovery time, nonstationary streams and adaptivity-information limits already formalized.
limitation: Cannot rely on specific bounds without reading assumptions/proofs; abstract does not imply a deployable selector guarantee.

title: Do ImageNet Classifiers Generalize to ImageNet?
read_scope: Official abstract and metadata
method_overlap: Natural resampling shift test for CIFAR/ImageNet.
limitation: Dataset collection difficulty differs from identifiable corruption cause; specify V2 subset.

title: The Many Faces of Robustness: A Critical Analysis of Out-of-Distribution Generalization
read_scope: CVF metadata/abstract and selective PDF robustness discussion
method_overlap: ImageNet-R and other real shifts; DeepAugment robust-source controls; simultaneous multiple shifts.
limitation: Improvements on local texture/corruption do not imply gains on geographic shifts; source training differs from test-time routing.
publication_status: Official ICCV2021 verified; CVF page pagination followed

title: Natural Adversarial Examples
read_scope: Official PDF header/abstract/introduction/figure1
method_overlap: ImageNet-A natural hard examples; ImageNet-O unseen-class detection is a separate task.
limitation: Subset class mapping and adversarial filtration matter; performance is not an illumination-only test.

title: Learning Robust Global Representations by Penalizing Local Predictive Power
read_scope: Official abstract/author metadata and arXiv abstract
method_overlap: Introduces ImageNet-Sketch; source representation should rely on global structure rather than local shortcuts.
limitation: Proceedings author order used; arXiv listing order differs. Sketch is representation/style shift not physical sensor corruption.

title: WILDS leaderboard submission guidelines
read_scope: Full standard/non-standard submission rules and current leaderboard metric headers
method_overlap: Test training and model selection prohibited even for non-standard submissions; batch statistics prohibited standard; designated unlabeled adaptation is different.
limitation: Accessed2026 date is not publication date. Official leaderboard contains historical ARM-BN and Test-time BN adaptation baseline rows; these do not establish permission for new test-trained submissions. Inference-only adaptation legality should not be blanket asserted. Declare a custom online-updating research protocol separately.
